Equipment:
 Time-Over Current Relays With Voltage Restraint For
 Generator

12IJCV51A14A,
 IJCV, Pick-up Range 1/4 amp, 0 volt, 4/16 amp 120 volt
 USA

These document outlines the 
 testing procedure P1, to be performed
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
 possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment and is 
 required to completely check the proper operation 
 and calibration of the relay.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Osman, 
 tested by eng Mahmoud Youssef, reversed by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel 
 Abd-Elqader Elnaggar, and approved by eng. Sawsan El_Lethy: 
 general director of Port Said Gas Turbine.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
 predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
Secondary injection test set.
Voltmeter, clamp ammeter.

Test leads, complete 
 tool set.

Disconnect the circuit breaker for 
 generator.

Removed the plug of connection for 
 Time-Over current relay.

Put the test plug of connection in 
 Time-Over current relay

Connect test leads between the test 
 set and the current terminal (5&6) for phase ( R ) in the test plug for the 
 Time-Over current relay.

Connect test leads between the test 
 set and the time terminal (1&2) for phase (R) in the test plug for the 
 Time-Over current relay.

Connect test leads between the test 
 set and the voltage terminal (7&8) for phase (R) in the test plug for the 
 Time-Over current relay.

At zero restraint volts Increase 
 the injected current slowly until the red indication on the Time-Over current 
 element phase ( R ) on the relay appears.

Record this value (of the current 
 and the time) on the test sheet 
 ( adjust it if needed ).
Switch off the test set.

Repeat the above test from step ( 4 
 ) to ( 8 ) but inject current between terminal ( 5 &6) for phase( S ) and 
 terminal ( 5&6 )for phase ( T ) and time terminal (1&2) for phase (S) and 
 terminal (1&2) for phase (T) and voltage terminal (7&8) for phase (S) and 
 terminal (7&8) for phase (T).

At { 48% of rated restraint 
 voltage(60volt a.c)} Increase the injected current slowly until the red 
 indication on the Time-Over current element phase ( R ) on the relay appears.

Record this value (of the Current 
 and the time) on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed ).
Switch off the test set.

Repeat the above test from step ( 
 11 ) to (12 ) but inject current between terminal ( 5 &6) for phase ( S ) and 
 terminal ( 5&6 )for phase ( T ) and time terminal (1&2) for phase (S) 
 and terminal (1&2) for phase (T) and voltage terminal (7&8) for phase (S) and 
 terminal (7&8) for phase (T).

15.At{100% of rated restraint 
 voltage(120volta.c)}Increase the injected current slowly until the red 
 indication on the Time-Over Current element phase (R) on the relay appears.

Record this value (of the Current 
 and the time) on the test sheet
 ( adjust it if needed ).
Switch off the test set.

Repeat the above test from step 
 (15) to (16) but inject current between terminal ( 5 &6) for phase ( S ) and 
 terminal ( 5&6 )for phase ( T ) and time terminal (1&2) for phase (S) 
 and terminal (1&2) for phase (T) and voltage terminal (7&8) for phase (S) and 
 terminal (7&8) for phase (T).

Disconnect the test 
 leads from terminal on the relay.

Remove the test plug 
 from the relay.

Put the plug of 
 connection for Time-Over 
 current relay.

sections.text:
If any equipment 
associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by 
the following restoration steps:

items: Breaker trip coil

Breaker failure scheme 
 associated this relay.

Disturbance alarm and 
 fault recorder associated with this relay.

Repeat the circuit 
 breaker of the generator to the normal position.
